tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You are organizing a holiday party for your student club. You need to find a venue that can host the event and provide the necessary facilities. You want to contact a local community center to ask about their availability, pricing, and what facilities they offer. Write an email to the community center manager, Mr. Khan.
bullets: Explain the purpose of the event and the expected number of attendees.
Ask about the available dates and costs for hosting the event.
Describe the facilities you'll need for the event and ask if the center can accommodate your requests.
tasks.subject: Inquiry about hosting an event
